name: EcoGym
description: EcoGym is an economic simulation environment designed to evaluate LLM agents on long-horizon planning and strategic decision-making. It features an effectively unbounded temporal horizon supporting evaluations lasting hundreds of simulated days or thousands of steps. Key environmental mechanics such as market elasticity and user retention formulas are intentionally hidden (latent), forcing agents to actively explore and learn the underlying causal structure through hypothesis testing.
reputation: Cited as a distinctive environment for long-horizon LLM evaluation with hidden latent mechanics; top LLMs shown to surpass a human baseline of ~1,404 average DAU.
notes: Latent mechanics (hidden rules) prevent shortcut strategies and encourage genuine causal learning. Unbounded horizon distinguishes it from fixed-episode benchmarks. Human baseline established at ~1,404 DAU after ~45 minutes of play.
